Review_Text: If you've ever been to Disneyland Paris you'll end up comparing the two. I visited Disney Hong Kong on an extremely hot day in May, but still had a blast! The park is relatively small compared to others, but it makes up for it with shorter wait times and great attractions like Mystic Manor and Big Grizzly Mountain. Don't miss the fireworks at night!

Its Disneyland! Always an amazing experience with family. The rides were fantastic, especially Space Mountain and the Pirates of the Caribbean. Food options inside the park were surprisingly good with plenty of variety. We stayed from morning rope-drop until closing time and loved every minute.

A lovely park, but getting very expensive. It was quite crowded during our visit, with waiting times exceeding 75 minutes for popular rides. The parades and character meet-and-greets were the highlight for our children. Recommend downloading the official mobile app to reserve fast-passes.

Visited with my family during our vacation. Everything was organized so efficiently. The staff and cast members were extremely polite and helpful. The kids especially loved the Peter Pan and Dumbo rides. A truly magical place that lives up to its reputation!

Great theme park for young children and families! The Iron Man Experience and Ant-Man attractions were highlights for Marvel fans. Very clean facilities throughout the entire park and easily accessible via the MTR subway line.
